headline: Insilico releases Longevity Grok, a multi-agent system for longitudinal health data
summary: Insilico Medicine announced Longevity Grok / Personal Longevity Superintelligence, a Grok Bot-based system described as organizing longitudinal personal health records, tracking biomarkers, proposing lifestyle interventions and scoring follow-up results. The company also describes physician-support and opt-in aging-research roles. These product functions are company claims; this review did not test the system, audit health-data handling or establish clinical benefit.
